parts.html: The K-01 kitchen collection combines timeless classical elegance with a distinctive green color palette and carefully selected furniture components. Its L-shaped configuration offers an efficient layout for cooking, food preparation, and everyday storage.
The upper and lower cabinets feature painted fronts in a coordinated solid green finish, creating a cohesive interior with a refined architectural appearance.
An acrylic stone countertop provides a practical work surface, while the 18 mm laminated chipboard cabinet construction forms a durable foundation for everyday use.
The kitchen is designed to accommodate built-in appliances and includes a pull-out cargo storage system for convenient access to kitchen essentials.
Hettich soft-close hinges and concealed Actro YOU Hettich drawer runners ensure smooth movement and comfortable operation. Cabinet handles are included in the configuration.
Drawer runners: Concealed Actro YOU Hettich.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, offers custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for residential projects in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-01 kitchen can be adapted to the dimensions of your space, allowing the cabinet layout, appliance integration, and storage configuration to reflect your individual requirements.
Our services include kitchen planning, custom manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Order your K-01 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and bring classic elegance into your home with a personalized furniture solution.
